analysis_route.name: rotating_modal
analysis_route.owner: AnalysisRouter dispatches; dedicated solver validates and orchestrates

rotation_config.axis_policy: finite nonzero 3-vector canonicalized to unit direction; direction sets right-hand sign
rotation_config.speed_policy: finite signed scalar in rad/s; zero is valid

rotating_disk.location: existing discrete mass collection; entity adjacent to ConcentratedMass
rotating_disk.mass_owner: one RotatingDisk entity owns its translational and rotary mass contribution
rotating_disk.mass_assembly: existing GlobalAssembler active_dofs()/matrix() path, exactly once
rotating_disk.gyro_assembly: specialized RotatingDiskGyroAssembler reads disk and contributes G only
rotating_disk.center_of_mass: at attachment node; initial route rejects offset
rotating_disk.inertia_tensor: Id*(I-a*a.T) + Ip*(a*a.T), in fixed global coordinates
rotating_disk.duplicate_guard: initial route rejects a generic ConcentratedMass at a rotating disk node
rotating_disk.route_guard: non-rotating analyses reject rotating disk entities before assembly

assembly.global_assembler_change: none planned; retain ownership of ordinary K/M
assembly.gyro_units_and_speed: G excludes Omega; QEP applies signed Omega exactly once
invariants: K, M, and G share shape and DofManager ordering
G is finite, real, and skew-symmetric
the same free-DOF index selection reduces K, M, and G

dof_reduction.initial_scope: BEAM2 with homogeneous fixed DOFs only
dof_reduction.method: select identical free index ordering for K, M, G

qep.interface: internal solve(M, K, G, omega_rad_s, options)
qep.equation: (lambda^2 M + lambda Omega G + K) phi = 0
validation: positive-definite reduced M for accepted initial cases
residuals evaluated against original quadratic polynomial
non-finite or malformed roots fail closed
qep.dense_size_limit: set only after multi-size resource characterization

result.dto: separate RotatingModalResult; ModalResult remains real-valued and unchanged
result.complex_serialization: explicit real/imag fields; no implicit complex-to-float conversion
fields: rotation axis, signed speed and frame convention
optional polarization/whirl with explicit defined/ambiguous status

campbell_boundaries.modal_tracking: complex mode association and ambiguity reporting
campbell_boundaries.degenerate_modes: track subspaces; do not claim unique vector identity
campbell_boundaries.ambiguity: retain explicit gaps/ambiguous intervals; never force smoothness

non_regression.required_validation: WP01 PR_REQUIRED workflows on exact WP02 head

required_ci.legacy_non_regression: WP01 PR_REQUIRED workflows on the exact WP02 head
required_ci.documentation_tests: WP01 Documentation tests workflow on the exact WP02 head
